{{Vanilla|Wheat}}

{{Infobox auto}}

'''Straw''' is the stalk left when wheat is harvested. It replaces {{MCW|Wheat|wheat}}, which in Matcha Flavoured is not a food ingredient: [[bread]] is made from [[dough]], and grain comes from [[Wheat Grain|wheat grain]]. Straw is used for building materials.

== Obtaining ==

=== Farming ===
A fully grown wheat crop drops 1 straw.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/wheat.json}}</ref>

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A hay bale crafts into 4 straw, and 2 tall dry grass into 1 straw.

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

Straw makes hay bales (4 straw), 2 tall dry grass each, and binds 8 mud into 8 packed mud for the [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]]. Obtaining straw unlocks the packed mud recipe.
